about: Post-hoc, exploratory checks of B2 Stage T made by the agents after Run B; not registered, and they cannot change a registered verdict. Computed only from the file named in source.

kept_draws_reproduced.definition: The registered selector applied to the clip rows keeps the stored kept run for every arm and item

j_reproduced.definition: J of every arm recomputed from the clip rows equals the stored J

wr_reproduced_from_transcript.definition: Stage T clips (of 480) whose stored WR is reproduced by the registered matcher from the stored transcript split at white space and hyphens

npa_v_times_notes_max_deviation.definition: Largest distance of NPA_v x (the line's note count) from a whole number over all clips; near 0 means NPA_v is a count of correct notes out of the line's notes

wr_times_words_max_deviation.definition: Largest distance of WR x (the line's word count) from a whole number over all clips

comparators.definition: The unclocked guided arms over which P1 takes the max (S*_b0, ctx_oohs_k3 and B* are one run, so two distinct J vectors)

delta_j.definition: J(S*) minus the largest comparator J

p2_5.definition: 2.5th percentile (numpy linear) of the bootstrap Delta_J: 10,000 resamples of the 24 items, default_rng(0).integers(0, 24, (10000, 24)), max over comparators retaken (decide_b2)

seeds_0_19_p2_5.definition: The same 2.5th percentile with default_rng(s) for s = 0 to 19

seeds_0_19_share_le_0.definition: Share of the 10,000 resamples with Delta_J <= 0, for s = 0 to 19

exact_p_le_0.definition: Exact ideal-bootstrap P(Delta_J <= 0): all 24^24 equally likely resamples counted by item category

exact_p_lt_0.definition: Exact ideal-bootstrap P(Delta_J < 0), counted the same way

exact_p2_5_is_0.definition: The ideal bootstrap's 2.5th percentile is exactly 0, since P(Delta_J < 0) < 0.025 <= P(Delta_J <= 0)

item_categories.definition: Items per category, the category being J(S*) - J(b) for each distinct comparator b (S*_b0, ctx_oohs_k4)

wins.definition: Items joint for S* and not for S*_b0

losses.definition: Items joint for S*_b0 and not for S*

ties.definition: Items joint for both or for neither

p_two_sided.definition: Exact two-sided binomial sign test on the untied items (p = 1/2)

j_ctc_same_kept_draws.definition: Items (of 24) whose kept draw, chosen by Whisper's q, has gate * min(NPA_v, CTC WR) >= 0.5

mean_wr_ctc.definition: Mean CTC WR over the arm's 96 clips

kept_s_star_minus_b0_mean_wr_ctc.definition: Mean over items of CTC WR of S*'s kept draw minus CTC WR of S*_b0's kept draw

kept_s_star_minus_b0_up_down_equal.definition: Items where that difference is > 0, < 0 and = 0

paired_96_s_star_minus_b0_mean_wr_ctc.definition: Mean over the 96 seed-paired clips of S*'s CTC WR minus S*_b0's

corr_wr_whisper_ctc.definition: Pearson correlation over the arm's 96 clips of Whisper WR and CTC WR

j_ctc_reselected.definition: Items (of 24) joint when the selector keeps the draw with the largest q_ctc = gate * min(NPA_v, CTC WR)

j_s_star_minus_1_note.definition: Items (of 24) joint for S* when every clip has one correct note fewer: NPA_v = (correct notes - 1) / (the line's notes), floor 0, the selector re-picking

j_s_star_minus_2_notes.definition: The same with two correct notes fewer

j_s_star_minus_1_word.definition: Items (of 24) joint for S* when every clip has one matched word fewer: WR = (matched words - 1) / (the line's words), floor 0, the selector re-picking

j_s_star_minus_2_words.definition: The same with two matched words fewer

items_lost_minus_1_note.definition: S*'s joint items that are no longer joint with one correct note fewer

wr_chance.definition: Mean over the arm's 96 clips of the clip's WR against each of the other 23 test lyrics (stored transcript, registered matcher), averaged over the 23

max_wr_against_other_lyric.definition: Largest WR of any clip of the arm against any other test lyric

s_star_minus_b0_wr_gain.definition: Mean WR of S* minus that of S*_b0

s_star_minus_b0_wr_gain_above_chance.definition: The same gain after subtracting each arm's WR chance

j_any_order.definition: Items (of 24) joint with q = gate * min(NPA_v, WR in any order), the stored wr_multiset, the selector re-picking by that q

mean_kept_q_any_order.definition: Mean over items of the largest any-order q

contrast_s_star_minus_shuf.definition: Mean over items of S*'s minus S*_shuf's kept any-order q, with the 95% interval of the registered item bootstrap (default_rng(0), 10,000 resamples, percentiles)

contrast_s_star_minus_b0.definition: The same for S* minus S*_b0

n_clips.definition: Seed-paired clips (same item and draw) with an onset error in both S* and S*_b0 (each clip with at least 4 matched words)

median_s_star.definition: Median absolute onset error (s) of S* over those clips

median_b0.definition: Median absolute onset error (s) of S*_b0 over those clips

n_clips_more_words.definition: Stage T clips (of 480) where the longest in-order match of lyric and transcript words finds more lyric words than the registered matcher

extra_words.definition: Extra words found on those clips, as {count: clips}

j_with_longest_match.definition: Items (of 24) joint with WR from the longest in-order match, the selector re-picking

item_j_unchanged.definition: Every arm's per-item J is the same as with the registered matcher, so Delta_J, its bootstrap and the verdict do not change

n_containing_a_registered_string.definition: Of those, transcripts that contain one of the registered E4 hallucination strings as whole words
